The point-line graph Laplacian decomposes into two constant modes, q-dimensional line-only kernel mode, and two (q²-1)-dimensional point-orthogonal modes with eigenvalues (2q+1±sqrt(4q+1))/2. PBH yields lower bound q²-1 controls and at least q selected distinct line classes. Black selected lines have two white point neighbours and selected black points at least q white line neighbours, so zero forcing stalls. Independent exact q=2 Kalman rank and stall check corroborated; axioms prove general existing planes, including non-Desarguesian cases.
